# Ruling004 synthetic fixture refreeze

The original fixture files and original manifest remain historical evidence without edits. Current tests use the separately named `ruling004-current--` copies and `ruling004-current-manifest.json`. The 372 existing case expectations and 90 required case IDs remain unchanged. `ruling004-adaptations.json` identifies each of the 256 before/after files with byte and explicitly LF-normalised content hashes. Git line-ending normalisation is not a semantic recipe/request migration.

The copies deliberately choose production_servings=1 for old synthetic selections, null unknown component production anchors, empty reused_inputs, and an all-zero synthetic food-input pin for the empty derived fixture. These are explicit fixture inputs, never production defaults, clocks, evidence admission or real household data. Recipe and enclosing valid request hashes were independently recalculated with Python JSON/SHA256; intentionally incorrect hashes remain incorrect. New canonical fixture copies have independently re-encoded expected preimages/variants. Embedded JSON-string artefact fragments and their exact byte bindings were updated in their current copies. No production output became a new expected hash.

The `ruling004-v4` subfolder contains six complete wire-family materials and two full saved-basis records from accepted manifest ba41e5af3fab492d243696082f4826b165a5f72fe0dcb1069f71abe4b53ebede. Root accepted independent expected-vector evidence after the same reviewer's clean R2 (loop/001/food-vector-review/acceptance-v4.md). Both historical contexts contain all21 requirement rows and pass the actual current validator; selected-only omission controls reject. Expected preimages/hashes are copied from the independent pack, never generated from production. The original v3 pack remains untouched as unaccepted historical chain evidence. Vector acceptance establishes expected data, not native implementation or real-food acceptance.

Native scheduling, allocation conservation, method/admission meaning, prior-owner attachment/occupancy closure, current applicability and persistence remain consumer responsibilities in their separate packages. Frozen food Task A API/source and the 55-case oracle are unchanged.
